title: In Human Memories. Technology, Creativity and Self-Determination: An Ethical Proposal
abstract: arXiv:2610.23651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This research investigates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in modern compositional practices, with a particular focus on two case studies: Convergence (2020/21) by Alexander Schubert, for String Ensemble and AI System, and In Human Memories (2024) by Francesco Vitucci, for four cellos and one electroacoustic player, whose installation was created by the Electronic Music School of the "N. Piccinni" Conservatory of Bari. The initial historical survey traces the evolving use of technology in composition, revealing how the search for new expressive possibilities has driven the development of technological tools through experimentation. The appearance of AI marks a fundamental shift: no longer just a tool, AI now poses questions and challenges to the composer. Engaging with AI becomes an exploration of an unknown entity, whose full capabilities are still largely undiscovered. This new interaction leads composers to confront AI not me

translated_title: 《人类记忆之中：技术、创造力与自主决定——一项伦理提案》
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了人工智能（AI）在现代作曲实践中的作用，特别聚焦于两个案例研究：亚历山大·舒伯特（Alexander Schubert）为弦乐合奏与AI系统创作的《Convergence》（2020/21），以及弗朗切斯科·维图奇（Francesco Vitucci）为四把大提琴与一名电声演奏者创作的《In Human Memories》（2024），其装置由巴里“N. Piccinni”音乐学院电子音乐系创作。文章首先进行历史考察，追溯了技术在作曲中不断演变的应用方式，揭示了对于新表达可能性的追寻如何通过实验推动了技术工具的发展。AI的出现标志着一个根本性的转变：AI不再仅仅是一个工具，而是开始向作曲家提出问题与挑战。与AI的互动成为对一种未知实体的探索，其完整能力在很大程度上仍有待发现。这种新的互动促使作曲家在与AI的对抗中不再……
tldr: 本研究通过分析两部融合AI的音乐作品，揭示了AI在现代作曲中已从单纯的工具转变为会向作曲家提出问题与挑战的未知对话者，并据此探讨技术与创造力、自我决定之间的伦理关系。
en_tdlr: Through two case studies of AI-integrated musical works, this research shows that AI has shifted from a mere tool to an unknown entity that poses questions and challenges to composers, raising ethical questions about technology, creativity, and self-determination.
